headline: Ichor Holdings Shares Gain on Strong Q4 Guidance Despite Revenue Miss
summary: Ichor stock rose following strong fourth-quarter guidance, offsetting a revenue miss in its latest financial report.
why: Forward-looking guidance provided by semiconductor equipment suppliers often carries more weight with investors than past quarterly revenue figures.

impacts.name: Ichor Holdings
impacts.why: Upbeat forward guidance reassured investors about future demand, overriding historical revenue shortfalls.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Optimistic future earnings projections overshadowed a lower-than-expected revenue report for the quarter.
